descriptions.C37: Enter a keyword and get keyword ideas, synonyms and similar terms from the same topic, with search volume. A keyword generator for brainstorming alternative wording.
descriptions.C38: Enter several keywords and get the keyword difficulty of each in one table. Compare which keywords look easier to rank for. Difficulty can be blank for keywords outside DataForSEO's SERP data.
descriptions.C39: Enter several keywords and see the search intent of each (informational, commercial, transactional, navigational) as shares in a table. Tell apart people who want to buy from people who want to learn.
descriptions.C40: Get search volume, CPC, keyword difficulty, search intent and a 12-month average for one keyword in a single table. A starting point for keyword analysis.
descriptions.C41: Enter a keyword and get its monthly search volume over past years as a table and a chart. See keyword seasonality: when the peak season comes each year.
descriptions.C42: Enter a domain and get the categories (topics) a site appears in on Google, with the number of keywords and estimated traffic per category. See which niches a competitor is strong in.
descriptions.C43: Get the most searched keywords, ordered by search volume. Browse the top Google searches. It is a list of high-volume keywords, not a list of what is rising fastest.
descriptions.C44: Enter several keywords and get the domains that rank for them, as a table. Competitor analysis for SEO: see which sites are strong across a group of keywords.
descriptions.C45: Enter a domain and get the keywords it ranks for on Google, with position and search volume. Use it for competitor keyword research and to see which keywords your own blog appears for.
descriptions.C46: Enter a domain and get competitor sites that rank for the same keywords. Find your rivals online with a competitor analysis tool.
descriptions.C47: Enter two domains and get the keywords both rank for. See how your keywords overlap with a competitor's: groundwork for keyword gap and content gap analysis.
descriptions.C48: Enter a domain and get the pages with the most estimated search traffic, in descending order. See which articles and pages are strongest on a competitor's site. Traffic is an estimate.
descriptions.C49: Enter a domain and get estimated organic search traffic and the number of keywords, plus keywords by position band. A website traffic checker for gauging a competitor's size. These are estimates from rankings, not real visits.
descriptions.C50: Enter a keyword and get the top 10 results from past SERP snapshots, snapshot by snapshot. See whether the top sites rotate or stay the same: a SERP history check.
descriptions.C51: Enter a domain and get estimated organic traffic for each of the last 12 complete months as a table and a chart. See whether your own or a rival's site is growing. The current month is left out because it is still in progress.
descriptions.C52: Enter two page URLs and get the keywords both pages rank for, with each page's position and search volume. Compare two top articles to see the keywords they share.
descriptions.C53: Enter several domains, one per line, and get each one's estimated organic traffic in one table. Compare website traffic across a list of sites, such as a prospect list.
descriptions.C60: Enter a URL and get the page's title, description, number of headings, word count, load time and SEO check flags as tables. An on-page SEO checker and a quick page audit.
descriptions.C61: Enter an article URL and get the text under each heading (H1 to H4) as a table. Extract the headings of a competitor's article to learn how it is structured.
descriptions.C62: Enter a URL and get four Lighthouse scores (performance, accessibility, best practices, SEO) for mobile, plus key speed metrics. A page speed test based on Lighthouse, the same engine behind PageSpeed Insights.
descriptions.C63: Enter a URL and get a full page screenshot as a single image. Capture a whole webpage from a URL and keep the image URL in CSV.
descriptions.C64: Enter a keyword such as a company or product name and get Japanese-language web pages that contain it, with title, URL, date and positive/negative shares. For brand monitoring research in Japan; it covers web pages, not social media posts.
descriptions.C65: Enter a keyword and get the number of web mentions, the sentiment split, page types, languages and the most frequent domains. A starting point for social listening and media monitoring: the big picture of a topic.
descriptions.C66: Enter a keyword and get the number of mentions that are positive, negative and neutral, and per emotion (happiness, love, fun, sadness, anger, share). A sentiment analysis of web mentions for PR research.
descriptions.C67: Enter a keyword and get monthly mention counts and sentiment counts for the last 12 complete months, as a table and a chart. See whether a brand or topic is being talked about more or less.
descriptions.C68: Pick a business-type word and a major Japanese city and get up to 100 local businesses with name, category, address, phone, website and rating. For lead lists and finding sales prospects in Japan.
descriptions.C69: Enter a shop name and area (Japan) and get its Google Business Profile details: name, category, rating, review count, address, phone, photo count and opening hours.
descriptions.C71: Enter a Japanese area and get hotel prices and ratings for one night, two adults, from next Saturday. Compare nearby hotel rates and the going price for a stay in Japan.
descriptions.C74: Enter a domain and get the technologies a site uses: CMS, servers, analytics, advertising and more. A website technology checker for tech stack lookups, in the spirit of Wappalyzer and BuiltWith.
descriptions.C75: Enter a technology name such as Shopify and get 10 Japanese sites that use it. Build a lead list of companies that run a given technology. The name is corrected to the right spelling before it is sent.
descriptions.C76: Enter a domain and get its registration date, changed date, expiry date and registrar. A WHOIS lookup and domain age checker. Some .jp domains come back with a blank expiry date.
